fields.name: heading
fields.label: Heading
fields.default: The money conversation you never got to have.

fields.name: paragraph
fields.label: Paragraph
fields.default: Not a budget lecture. Not a product pitch. An hour with someone who listens first, then helps you build a simple money map you'll actually follow.

fields.name: heading
fields.label: Heading
fields.default: Three steps. No homework before the first one.

fields.name: paragraph
fields.label: Paragraph
fields.default: Free, no pressure. You tell me what's going on, I tell you honestly whether coaching will help and which option fits.

fields.name: paragraph_2
fields.label: Paragraph 2
fields.default: The first session is about where your habits came from, not a spreadsheet. We find the pattern before we touch the numbers.

fields.name: paragraph_3
fields.label: Paragraph 3
fields.default: A one-page plan you understand and can repeat: what comes in, what goes where, what you're building towards. Then we keep you on it.

fields.name: heading
fields.label: Heading
fields.default: Pick the shape. We'll agree the details on the call.

fields.name: paragraph
fields.label: Paragraph
fields.default: A one-to-one journey over several sessions. Rewrite your money story, fix the habits that keep you broke, build the emergency fund, and start investing with a plan you understand.

fields.name: text
fields.label: Text
fields.default: Best for: earning well, nothing to show for it

fields.name: text_2
fields.label: Text 2
fields.default: Your own forecasting and expense-tracking templates

fields.name: paragraph_2
fields.label: Paragraph 2
fields.default: Talk about money without it turning into a fight. Understand each other's money types, align on what you're building, and set up accounts and habits that work for both of you.

fields.name: text_4
fields.label: Text 4
fields.default: Best for: one saver, one spender, or two who never talk about it

fields.name: text_5
fields.label: Text 5
fields.default: Both money type quizzes, read together

fields.name: text_6
fields.label: Text 6
fields.default: A joint money map and a bills setup you both agree on

fields.name: text_7
fields.label: Text 7
fields.default: Not ready for a programme? Start with one session.

fields.name: text_8
fields.label: Text 8
fields.default: A 90-minute deep-dive on one money question. Property or stocks? Pay off the loan or invest? Take the job or not? You leave with a simple map and clear next steps.

fields.name: eyebrow
fields.label: Small label
fields.default: The things we don't say out loud

fields.name: heading
fields.label: Heading
fields.default: Does any of this sound like you?

fields.name: chip
fields.label: Chip
fields.default: "I earn well. So why is there nothing left on the 28th?"

fields.name: chip_2
fields.label: Chip 2
fields.default: "My partner and I only talk about money when we're fighting about it."

fields.name: chip_3
fields.label: Chip 3
fields.default: "I'm 38 and I still don't have an emergency fund."

fields.name: chip_4
fields.label: Chip 4
fields.default: "Everyone thinks I'm doing fine. I'm not."

fields.name: chip_5
fields.label: Chip 5
fields.default: "I don't open the bills. I know, I know."

fields.name: paragraph
fields.label: Paragraph
fields.default: Nobody taught us this. Most of us were told not to even talk about it. That silence is the real problem, and it's the first thing we fix.

fields.name: heading
fields.label: Heading
fields.default: Don't take my word for it

fields.name: text
fields.label: Text
fields.default: No. Luca is a Certified Money Coach, not a licensed investment adviser, and Money Coaching Hub is not a regulated investment firm. Coaching helps you understand your own behaviour, build a plan and make informed decisions. Nobody tells you what to buy and no products are sold.

fields.name: text_2
fields.label: Text 2
fields.default: It depends on the shape: a single session, an individual programme or couples coaching. I'll give you the exact figure on the 10-minute call, once I know what you need, so you're not paying for sessions you don't.

fields.name: text_3
fields.label: Text 3
fields.default: Either. Most sessions run on Google Meet, which is how clients from across Europe work with me. If you're in Malta and prefer to sit across a table, we can do that too.

fields.name: question_4
fields.label: Question 4
fields.default: Do I need to prepare anything?

fields.name: text_4
fields.label: Text 4
fields.default: Nothing before the call. Before the first session I'll send a short intake form so we don't spend your hour collecting numbers. Bring honesty; the numbers can be messy.

fields.name: question_5
fields.label: Question 5
fields.default: What if I'm embarrassed about my situation?

fields.name: text_5
fields.label: Text 5
fields.default: Everyone is, at first. I've sat with people earning six figures with nothing saved, and people with hundreds of thousands in the bank too scared to move it. There's no situation I haven't seen, and none I'll judge.

fields.name: heading
fields.label: Heading
fields.default: Ten minutes. No pitch. Just a conversation.

fields.name: paragraph
fields.label: Paragraph
fields.default: Tell me what's going on with your money. I'll tell you honestly whether coaching will help.
